title: Buccaneers GM Jason Licht 'in mourning' over Mike Evans joining 49ers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buccaneers GM Jason Licht 'in mourning' over Mike Evans joining 49ers
sources.description: Buccaneers GM Jason Licht acknowledged he "doesn't feel betrayed" about Mike Evans signing with the 49ers in free agency, but he is "in mourning."
